metadata.title: जंगल पर आदिवासी का हक़ छीना | Adivasi Forcefully stopped from collecting Lakh | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
The Forest Rights Act of 2006 grants Adivasis and forest dwellers the right to collect forest produce from all forest areas. However, despite this legal protection, tribals in Konatoli village of Gumla are denied their right to collect lakh from the forest. The Adivasis have alleged that upper-caste individuals are preventing them from accessing this natural resource.

They further informed Main Bhi Bharat that the forest department had allocated seven trees to each family in the village, including upper-caste families, for lakh collection. However, these families are not adhering to the orders, effectively depriving the tribals of their rightful share.
